newsitem.title: USA: CVS to meet with Revco staff.
newsitem.headline: CVS to meet with Revco staff.

text.p: Revco D.S. Inc said Wednesday CVS Corp executives plan to meet with Revco's headquarters management group and its regional office managers this week.
Rhode Island-based CVS Corp said last week it will acquire rival Revco in a stock deal valued at $2.8 billion (based on the February 6 closing stock prices) plus debt assumption.
The merger will create the largest drug store chain in terms of store count with about 4,000 stores in 24 states, and second largest, after Walgreen Co, in terms of sales.
The companies have said they expect to close Revco's Twinsburg, Ohio, headquarters, which employs about 950.
However, CVS has said it will keep about 98 percent of Revco's 39,000 workers.

CVS vice chairman and chief operating officer Thomas Ryan and a store operations executive are expected to meet with about 80 headquarters workers Thursday, then travel to regional offices in suburban Cleveland, Indianapolis and suburban Charlotte, N.C., Revco spokesman Thomas Dingledy said in a telephone interview.
The meetings will not be open to reporters, he said.
Pending shareholder and regulatory approval, the deal is expected to close by midyear, the companies have said.
